meta.name: terraform-module-library
meta.description: Build reusable Terraform modules for AWS, Azure, GCP, and OCI infrastructure following infrastructure-as-code best practices. Use when creating infrastructure modules, standardizing cloud provisioning, or implementing reusable IaC components.

copy.tagline_en: Build reusable infrastructure modules across clouds with code.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're writing reusable Terraform modules for multi-cloud infrastructure.

howto.what: 按标准模块结构产出可复用的 Terraform 模块:main.tf、variables.tf、outputs.tf、versions.tf、README、examples 示例和 Terratest 测试,覆盖 AWS、Azure、GCP、OCI 常见资源模式。
howto.when: 当你要创建基础设施模块、统一云资源供给,或实现可复用的 IaC 组件时接管,并按标准模块模式给出代码。

howto.what_en: Produces reusable Terraform modules in a standard layout — main.tf, variables.tf, outputs.tf, versions.tf, README, examples, and Terratest tests — for AWS, Azure, GCP, and OCI resources.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you create infrastructure modules, standardize cloud provisioning, or build reusable IaC components; it then generates code following the standard module pattern.

say_en.text: Write an AWS VPC module with private subnets and an internet gateway
say_en.note: Generates main.tf and other standard files

say_en.note: Shows module composition and output references

say_en.text: Add a Terratest test file for this module
